_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A Sandy Scandal#000.src: Before anybody could hear me, a large explosion occurred inside of the house the bandits intruded.
A Sandy Scandal#000.dst: 还没等任何人听见我，强盗闯入的那栋房子里就发生了一场大爆炸。

A Sandy Scandal#001.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Sandy Scandal#002.src: You look like a hardy one! {p} army is it? Would you be willing to help {p} a bit?
A Sandy Scandal#002.dst: 你看起来挺能扛的！{p} 军队的是吧？愿不愿意帮 {p} 一点忙？
A Sandy Scandal#002.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#003.src: {p} bank tends to be a prime target for bandits, and there's been a string of incidents that have made us suspicious.
A Sandy Scandal#003.dst: {p} 银行一向是强盗的头号目标，最近又接连出了几件事，让我们起了疑心。
A Sandy Scandal#003.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#004.src: We're looking into some witness reports to try and gain information on the bandits' plan.
A Sandy Scandal#004.dst: 我们正在调查一些目击报告，想弄清楚强盗的计划。
A Sandy Scandal#004.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#005.src: If I give you some of the reports, will you help check them out for clues?
A Sandy Scandal#005.dst: 如果我给你几份报告，你愿意帮忙去查查线索吗？
A Sandy Scandal#005.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#006.src: Great! The store from the first witness report is straight down the stairs, just past this building right behind me.
A Sandy Scandal#006.dst: 太好了！第一份目击报告里的那家店，从楼梯直走下去，就在我身后这栋楼过去一点。
A Sandy Scandal#006.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#007.src: It's called "Gibbs' Mining Supply Store", and the owner reported a robbery a few days ago.
A Sandy Scandal#007.dst: 那家店叫“Gibbs 采矿用品店”，店主几天前报了一起抢劫案。
A Sandy Scandal#007.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#008.src: Good luck! Report back to me if you find any information.
A Sandy Scandal#008.dst: 祝你好运！找到什么情报就回来向我报告。
A Sandy Scandal#008.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#009.src: Go to the witness report location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#010.src: Hello gentlemen! What can I interest you in today? Some industrial torches? Pickaxes?
A Sandy Scandal#010.dst: 你们好啊，先生们！今天想看点什么？工业火把？镐子？
A Sandy Scandal#010.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#011.src: Shut yer’ trap, old man. We came for a different kind of business.
A Sandy Scandal#011.dst: 闭上你的嘴，老头。我们来谈的是另一种生意。
A Sandy Scandal#011.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#012.src: Wha-? Look, fellows. Just step out of my store, and nobody gets hurt. I don't want any trouble.
A Sandy Scandal#012.dst: 什——？听着，伙计们。你们离开我的店，谁都不会受伤。我不想惹麻烦。
A Sandy Scandal#012.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#013.src: Listen up old man, tell us the code to the TNT vault in the basement, or I decorate my necklace with your fingers!
A Sandy Scandal#013.dst: 听好了老头，告诉我们地下室 TNT 金库的密码，不然我就拿你的手指来装饰我的项链！
A Sandy Scandal#013.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#014.src: Certainly not! That TNT is for licensed mining companies only, not your average amateur miner.
A Sandy Scandal#014.dst: 休想！那些 TNT 只卖给有执照的采矿公司，不是给你们这种业余矿工的。
A Sandy Scandal#014.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#015.src: Well then! I guess you'll still be able to grasp a pick with four fingers, eh?
A Sandy Scandal#015.dst: 那好吧！我猜你剩四根手指也还握得住镐子，是吧？
A Sandy Scandal#015.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#016.src: Gaaah! Alright, alright! No more violence, please!
A Sandy Scandal#016.dst: 啊啊啊！好，好！别再动手了，拜托！
A Sandy Scandal#016.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#017.src: The code is {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... please don't hurt me!
A Sandy Scandal#017.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#018.src: {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... thanks! We won't be needing you anymore... now go to sleep!
A Sandy Scandal#018.dst: {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}……谢啦！我们不再需要你了……现在睡一觉吧！
A Sandy Scandal#018.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#019.src: Open the vault in the basement [Code: {~}].
A Sandy Scandal#019.dst: 打开地下室的金库 [密码：{~}]。

A Sandy Scandal#022.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Sandy Scandal#023.src: Ah, you're back! Did you find anything interesting in the report?
A Sandy Scandal#023.dst: 啊，你回来了！报告里有什么有意思的发现吗？
A Sandy Scandal#023.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#024.src: Missing TNT in the shop's vault? Looks like the shopkeeper was telling the truth.
A Sandy Scandal#024.dst: 店里的金库少了 TNT？看来店主说的是实话。
A Sandy Scandal#024.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#025.src: We need to catch these criminals quickly if they have access to that amount of TNT - they could blow a hole right into the bank's vault!
A Sandy Scandal#025.dst: 如果这些罪犯手上有那么多 TNT，我们得赶快抓住他们——他们能直接炸穿银行的金库！
A Sandy Scandal#025.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#026.src: You should check out another witness report, from after the attack on the shopkeeper.
A Sandy Scandal#026.dst: 你应该去看看另一份目击报告，是店主遇袭之后的。
A Sandy Scandal#026.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#027.src: It was taken from the rooftop garden of the Scroll Merchant's residence, you should take a look.
A Sandy Scandal#027.dst: 那份报告是从卷轴商人家的屋顶花园得来的，你该去看看。
A Sandy Scandal#027.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#028.src: Be quick! We don't have much time if we want to stop these bandits.
A Sandy Scandal#028.dst: 快点！如果想阻止这些强盗，我们没多少时间了。
A Sandy Scandal#028.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#029.src: Go to the witness report location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#031.src: Ey', what do you two blighters think you're doing with those dangerous explosives in the city?
A Sandy Scandal#031.dst: 喂，你们两个混蛋拿着那些危险的炸药在城里干什么？
A Sandy Scandal#031.speaker: Scroll Merchant

A Sandy Scandal#032.src: Guards! Guards! Robber! Come quick! Urgently!
A Sandy Scandal#032.dst: 守卫！守卫！有强盗！快来！十万火急！
A Sandy Scandal#032.speaker: Scroll Merchant

A Sandy Scandal#034.src: Find the source of the detonation at [{~}, {~}, {~}].

A Sandy Scandal#036.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#037.src: Were you able to uncover any new information regarding the status of the criminals?
A Sandy Scandal#037.dst: 关于那些罪犯的动向，你查到什么新情报了吗？
A Sandy Scandal#037.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#038.src: Ah... that's troubling. The criminals plundered two very powerful weapons.
A Sandy Scandal#038.dst: 啊……这可麻烦了。那些罪犯抢走了两件非常强大的武器。
A Sandy Scandal#038.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#039.src: It won't be easy facing those criminals if they decide to raid the bank with those weapons.
A Sandy Scandal#039.dst: 如果他们决定带着那些武器来抢银行，要对付他们可不容易。
A Sandy Scandal#039.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#040.src: I'm not certain how to proceed from here, we didn't receive any more witness reports, and-
A Sandy Scandal#040.dst: 我不确定接下来该怎么办，我们没有再收到目击报告，而且——
A Sandy Scandal#040.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#041.src: Boss, I just received urgent reports of a robbery underway in the left residential area of {p}!
A Sandy Scandal#041.dst: 老大，我刚收到紧急报告，{p} 左边的住宅区正在发生抢劫！
A Sandy Scandal#041.speaker: Almuj Sentry

A Sandy Scandal#042.src: Oh my… you! Soldier! Quick! The robbery is taking place across the bridge, next to the first house you visited today! It may be the bandits we're looking for.
A Sandy Scandal#042.dst: 天哪……你！士兵！快！抢劫就发生在桥对面，在你今天去过的第一栋房子旁边！可能就是我们在找的强盗。
A Sandy Scandal#042.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#043.src: There will be somebody waiting for you outside of the house once you get to the residential area!
A Sandy Scandal#043.dst: 你到住宅区之后，会有人在那栋房子外面等你！
A Sandy Scandal#043.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#044.src: If you still can't find it, I've written the coordinates in your content book. Now quickly, get to the house!
A Sandy Scandal#044.dst: 如果你还是找不到，我已经把坐标写在你的内容书里了。快，赶去那栋房子！
A Sandy Scandal#044.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#045.src: Quickly! Go to the house at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#046.src: Hello? Are you with the guards? Good! Hurry! Some bandits just ransacked my house, and left with lots of emeralds!
A Sandy Scandal#046.dst: 你好？你是守卫那边的吗？太好了！快！有一群强盗刚把我家洗劫一空，带着一大堆绿宝石跑了！
A Sandy Scandal#046.speaker: Almuj Citizen

A Sandy Scandal#047.src: Follow me to my house, hopefully you can find the bandits! They stole lots of my precious gems!
A Sandy Scandal#047.dst: 跟我去我家，希望你能找到那些强盗！他们偷走了我好多珍贵的宝石！
A Sandy Scandal#047.speaker: Almuj Citizen

A Sandy Scandal#048.src: Look for signs of the bandits' whereabouts.

A Sandy Scandal#050.src: Ready, boys? We've got the TNT, weapons, and the fastest horses those emeralds could buy. Now we just-
A Sandy Scandal#050.dst: 准备好了吗，弟兄们？TNT、武器都到手了，还有那些绿宝石买得到的最快的马。现在我们只要——
A Sandy Scandal#050.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#051.src: Ahah. I had a feeling we had a guard on our tail.
A Sandy Scandal#051.dst: 啊哈。我就感觉有守卫跟在我们后面。
A Sandy Scandal#051.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#052.src: No point wasting these brand-new weapons on you... since we're blowing up this hideout anyway!
A Sandy Scandal#052.dst: 没必要把这些全新的武器浪费在你身上……反正我们本来就要炸掉这个藏身处！
A Sandy Scandal#052.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#053.src: This whole thing'll go up in a few seconds, and any evidence will be buried in the sand. Good luck getting out of here!
A Sandy Scandal#053.dst: 几秒钟后这整个地方就会炸上天，所有证据都会埋进沙子里。祝你能逃出去！
A Sandy Scandal#053.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#055.src: Find where the bandits blasted a hole to get into the bank at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#055.dst: 找到强盗在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 炸开洞口进入银行的地方。

A Sandy Scandal#056.src: It’s too late to stop us now! We’re already about to bust out of here with the grand prize - the contents of the emerald vault!
A Sandy Scandal#056.dst: 现在想阻止我们已经太迟了！我们正准备带着头奖——绿宝石金库里的东西——冲出去！
A Sandy Scandal#056.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#057.src: Follow the criminals into the other room.
A Sandy Scandal#057.dst: 跟着罪犯进入另一个房间。

A Sandy Scandal#058.src: Look here, the soldier decided they wanted to follow us. Dumb move.
A Sandy Scandal#058.dst: 你们看，这个士兵决定跟着我们。蠢到家了。
A Sandy Scandal#058.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#059.src: I guess we can kill two birds with one stone: escaping the bank, and killing this pest.
A Sandy Scandal#059.dst: 我想我们可以一举两得：逃出银行，顺便干掉这个讨厌鬼。
A Sandy Scandal#059.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#062.src: Report back to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#063.src: Soldier! Where did you disappear to? Did you hear those explosions, below the bank?
A Sandy Scandal#063.dst: 士兵！你跑哪去了？你听到银行底下的爆炸声了吗？
A Sandy Scandal#063.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#064.src: We think those bandits might have made their first move in the heist, we're mobilising a troop to-
A Sandy Scandal#064.dst: 我们认为那些强盗可能已经开始动手了，正在调派一支部队去——
A Sandy Scandal#064.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#065.src: You've already stopped them? And reclaimed the stolen weapons and explosives..?
A Sandy Scandal#065.dst: 你已经阻止他们了？还夺回了被偷的武器和炸药……？
A Sandy Scandal#065.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#066.src: Wow. Excellent work, soldier. {p} is in your debt. Please accept these from our vault, as a token of our thanks.
A Sandy Scandal#066.dst: 哇。干得太好了，士兵。{p} 欠你一份人情。请收下这些从我们金库拿出来的东西，聊表谢意。
A Sandy Scandal#066.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard
